title: Inventory Value today drops by exactly the part value when its tracking is turned off
custom_preconds:
• A tracked part with stock and no negative bins (for example qty 1 at $50.89).
  • Reports > Inventory Value, As of today, its location.
custom_steps:
1. Note the Totals row (Qty and Total Cost) and search the part: it is listed.
  2. In Inventory, open the part, switch tracking OFF, Save.
  3. Re-run Inventory Value for today and read Totals; search the part.
  4. Switch tracking back ON and re-run.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • The part is listed with its qty and cost.

Step 3:

  • The part is not listed.
  • Totals Qty drops by the part qty and Total Cost drops by exactly its value (e.g. 62,268 → 62,267 and $483,807.15 → $483,756.26).

Step 4:

  • The part is listed again and totals return to the step 1 values.
